17	# Micro-Decomposition Engine
18	
19	## Problem
20	
21	System is 85% local for KNOWN patterns but 0% local for novel/complex questions. Big strategic questions ("achieve like Giang Trần Minh Thành — $450M fund director at 25") get single-prompt LLM response — zero decomposition, zero verification, zero compound learning.
22	
23	## Solution
24	
25	Decompose big questions into 15-40 micro-factual queries. LLM retrieves ONE fact per query (no reasoning). LOCAL engine: decomposes, verifies, stores, synthesizes. Every run trains templates + accumulates facts → compound intelligence.
26

31	  → decomposer.py: classify → select dimensions → generate micro-queries
32	    → micro_query_runner.py: fire queries, enforce JSON response
33	    → fact_assembler.py: verify + deduplicate + store in decision-vectors.db
34	  → synthesis_engine.py: LOCAL-ONLY scoring + gap analysis + path generation

12	## Overview
13	
14	Track which decomposition templates produce useful facts. Evolve templates over time: promote high-yield dimensions, demote low-yield ones, refine query wording. Every decomposition run feeds the evolution loop.

18	- Functional: Track per-template metrics: facts_produced, avg_confidence, usefulness_score
19	- Functional: Auto-adjust dimension weights based on historical yield
20	- Functional: Auto-refine query templates based on parse success rate
21	- Functional: Fact compounding — reuse accumulated facts to skip redundant queries
22	- Non-functional: Evolution stored in SQLite (decomposition_templates table)
23	- Non-functional: Max 10% weight change per evolution cycle (stability)

25	## Architecture
26	
27	```
28	Post-Decomposition Metrics
29	  → TemplateEvolver.evolve(decomposition_id, results)
30	    → Per dimension: yield = facts_added / queries_fired
31	    → Per template: parse_success_rate, avg_confidence
32	    → Weight adjustment: new_weight = old_weight × (1 + yield_delta × 0.1)
33	    → Template refinement: if parse_fail > 30% → flag for manual review
34	  → CompoundCache: domain → pre-resolved facts → skip in next decomposition
35	```
